title: Juicy Middle Eastern Morbier Mansaf
description: A comforting and umami-rich Middle Eastern dish featuring morbier cheese, served with a side of cure and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, in the form of a traditional mansaf.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic mixture, sliced morbier cheese, cure, and sumac.
Mix well to combine and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together the jameed and 1 cup of water.
Brush the pita bread with the jameed mixture and toast until crispy.
To assemble the mansaf, place a piece of toasted pita bread on a plate, followed by a spoonful of the morbier cheese mixture, and top with chopped parsley and pine nuts.
